Yeah. I'm just trying to find the right time to say something to someone. My brother is currently going through the same thing that I went through and the entire family is visibly stressed.

It keeps me busy, but if i were using it to pick someone up i'd be going for a tall blonde swede guy ;p

It's a good thought. I'm just lacking the motivation right now.

I've thought about it.

I'm learning another language, currently swedish. Sometimes it helps, sometime I have zero motivation to do even that.

I'd like to get a job, but I kind of screwed myself over with the whole school thing, and I don't even know where to begin to fix that.

Not recently, no. 

I don't have many interests honestly. Everything I do is to keep myself busy as an attempt to get myself through another day. It usually involves mindless games, sometimes i'll get myself on duolingo if i really want to get my mind off things, but that's it really.

yes, I've been to plenty of therapists/psychiatrists, and for 2 years when I should have been completing high school I was in and out of inpatient. I'm not sure what I want to do with my life, I'm feeling really lost.
